Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Hair: her hair gathered into a loose low ponytail over one shoulder — same colour and length as the attached image.

COMPOSITION: a waist-up shot of her head, torso and hands; body turned three-quarters away from the camera; looking back over her own left shoulder — the shoulder on the image's left side: her chin comes to rest just above that shoulder, which dips slightly toward the camera, and her upper back turns a little with her head so her shoulder blade and the curve of her spine show, while her hips stay turned away — a natural, unhurried glance back; camera slightly above, looking down at her; her chest stays turned away — never a full twist that squares her chest to the camera; the look-back comes from her head and a slight turn of her upper back only; the space runs far back behind her, its lines receding into the distance.

LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests naturally for the posture, relaxed and empty — her near arm, on the image's left side toward the camera.

EXPRESSION: level brow, calm unhurried eyes, mouth closed and composed.

Framing: a waist-up shot — the bottom edge crosses her waist; hips, legs and feet are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — two faces of one element: black soot and clear diamond; hexagonal lattices (graphite, graphene) as patterns, pencil-graphite grey, carbon-fibre weave; it bonds with everything and is the frame of all life — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: statuesque, long-legged, with a natural neck length — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text or numbers other than her element's own symbol and atomic number, no logo or watermark. Any animal or creature that belongs to the place stays separate from her at its own natural scale — never touching, held by or merged with her body.
